# Conversion

![Conversion function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/numeric/30-conversion.svg)

[Numeric functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Opens numeric, Boolean, string and byte-array conversion functions.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [To I8](conversion/to_i8.md) | Converts the input to an 8-bit signed integer. |
| [To I16](conversion/to_i16.md) | Converts the input to a 16-bit signed integer. |
| [To I32](conversion/to_i32.md) | Converts the input to a 32-bit signed integer. |
| [To I64](conversion/to_i64.md) | Converts the input to a 64-bit signed integer. |
| [To U8](conversion/to_u8.md) | Converts the input to an 8-bit unsigned integer. |
| [To U16](conversion/to_u16.md) | Converts the input to a 16-bit unsigned integer. |
| [To U32](conversion/to_u32.md) | Converts the input to a 32-bit unsigned integer. |
| [To U64](conversion/to_u64.md) | Converts the input to a 64-bit unsigned integer. |
| [To SGL](conversion/to_sgl.md) | Converts the input to a 32-bit floating-point value. |
| [To DBL](conversion/to_dbl.md) | Converts the input to a 64-bit floating-point value. |
| [To CSG](conversion/to_csg.md) | Converts the input to a single-precision complex value. |
| [To CDB](conversion/to_cdb.md) | Converts the input to a double-precision complex value. |
| [To FXP](conversion/to_fxp.md) | Converts the input to a fixed-point value. |
| [To CFX](conversion/to_cfx.md) | Converts the input to a complex fixed-point value. |
| [Number To Boolean Array](conversion/number_to_boolean_array.md) | Expands the bits of a number into a Boolean array. |
| [Boolean Array To Number](conversion/boolean_array_to_number.md) | Packs Boolean array values into a numeric bit pattern. |
| [Boolean To Integer](conversion/boolean_to_integer.md) | Converts false and true to their integer representations. |
| [Format Into String](conversion/format_into_string.md) | Formats one or more values into a string. |
| [String To Byte Array](conversion/string_to_byte_array.md) | Converts string storage into an array of bytes. |
| [Byte Array To String](conversion/byte_array_to_string.md) | Builds a string from an array of bytes. |
| [Number To Decimal String](conversion/number_to_decimal_string.md) | Formats a number using decimal notation. |
| [Number To Hex String](conversion/number_to_hex_string.md) | Formats a number using hexadecimal notation. |
| [Number To Octal String](conversion/number_to_octal_string.md) | Formats a number using octal notation. |
| [Number To Fractional String](conversion/number_to_fractional_string.md) | Formats a number with a fixed count of fractional digits. |
| [Number To Exponential String](conversion/number_to_exponential_string.md) | Formats a number using exponential notation. |
| [Number To Engineering String](conversion/number_to_engineering_string.md) | Formats a number with an exponent constrained to multiples of three. |
| [Decimal String To Number](conversion/decimal_string_to_number.md) | Parses a decimal string into a numeric value. |
| [Hex String To Number](conversion/hex_string_to_number.md) | Parses a hexadecimal string into a numeric value. |
| [Octal String To Number](conversion/octal_string_to_number.md) | Parses an octal string into a numeric value. |
| [Floating String To Number](conversion/floating_string_to_number.md) | Parses a floating-point string into a numeric value. |
